commands.purpose: Unit test suite for W4-028 method registry, baseline adapters, exact replay, incremental, and capability matrix
Audit check verifying integrity of 214 protected files

changed_files.description: Method adapter implementations for M00-M16: BaseMethodAdapter, baselines (M00, M01, M16), singleton replay (M02), incremental engine (M03), heuristic (M04), regional bounding adapters (M05-M11), policy axes (M12, M13), and audited applicability rows (M14, M15).
Comprehensive test suite covering W4-028 checklist items C01 through C07 (7/7 tests passing).

artifacts.description: Formal capability registry for 17 methods M00-M16 with semantic groups, threat models, parity check results, and scientific dispositions.

requirement_evidence.evidence: All 17 methods M00-M16 registered matching configs/week4/methods.json; separated into baselines (M00, M01, M16), singleton reuse (M02), incremental feature reuse (M03), heuristic (M04), regional certification (M05-M11), policy axes (M12, M13), and applicability-only audits (M14, M15). Verified by test_c01_method_registration_and_semantic_grouping.

M00 (NO_INTEGRITY_CHECK), M01 (PER_QUERY_INTEGRITY_CHECK), and M16 (OWNED_PROCESS_BOUNDARY) share identical QueryView input contract and return identical predictions and logits (100% agreement down to 0.0 ULP / float32 tolerance). Verified by test_c02_input_output_contract_and_identity_threat_models.

M02 uses full canonical input float32 bytes + SHA-256 with bitwise equality check; strictly records is_singleton_reuse=True and is_regional_reuse=False without claiming broad regional certificate coverage. Invalidates on recording boundary or stream discontinuity. Verified by test_c03_exact_input_replay_singleton_semantics.

M03 binds to W4-021 equivalence_capability() with BACKEND_EQUIVALENT_FORWARD target; M04 heuristic adapter tracks empirical distance without false formal badge. Verified by test_c04_incremental_eligibility_and_heuristic_budget.

M05-M11 adapters expose per-method numerical status (CONDITIONAL_REAL_ARITHMETIC, VALIDATED_FLOAT32_ENCLOSURE, CORRELATED_COORDINATE_HULL, NATIVE_CORRELATED_BOUNDS, SURROGATE_BACKWARD_RELAXATION) and descriptive failure reasons instead of a single shared boolean. Verified by test_c05_per_method_numerical_status_and_failure_reasons.

Prediction interface accepts strictly QueryView or raw (6, 128) array with zero lookahead and zero ground-truth label access; full forward is only executed as a fallback on miss. Verified by test_c06_zero_leakage_and_prediction_interface.

M14 and M15 raise fail-closed UnsupportedMethodError with detailed reasons from W4-029; policy axes M12 and M13 declare parent methods; method_capabilities.json artifact generated and validated. Verified by test_c07_unsupported_rows_policy_axes_and_artifact_generation.

scientific_dispositions.H06_global_lipschitz_conservatism: M05 correctly exposes CONDITIONAL_REAL_ARITHMETIC status and pair-margin spectral constants.
scientific_dispositions.H13_incremental_arithmetic_equivalence: M03 achieves bitwise and decision parity with M00, verified via im2col/sgemm equivalence from W4-021.
scientific_dispositions.H18_identity_mode_cost_profile: Distinct threat models explicitly documented for M00, M01, and M16.
scientific_dispositions.H19_vanishing_coverage: Explicitly distinguishes singleton input replay (M02) from regional certified reuse.
scientific_dispositions.H20_assertion_overhead: M01 wrapper isolates per-query SHA-256 overhead from inference core.
scientific_dispositions.H21_applicability_matrix: Audited rows M14 and M15 explicitly registered as non-executable under frozen scope.
scientific_dispositions.H22_numerical_status_separation: Each method exposes its own numerical status rather than a shared boolean.
scientific_dispositions.H24_causal_selector_contract: Adapters receive strictly QueryView or raw array with zero lookahead and zero ground truth.

limitations: M02 exact replay only covers bitwise identical windows, not continuous sensor trajectories.
M08 coordinate hull produces negative margins for large budgets due to correlation loss (H11).
M14 (LipCache) and M15 (StreamiNNC/TinyDejaVu) are audited applicability rows and excluded from execution benchmarking.
